The '''Rebel Base''' was an installation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] operated by the [[Barkhesh Resistance]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Barkhesh Resistance offered supplies to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. A supply [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] left the base, escorted by the Rebel's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], to hook up with an Alliance [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. Rogue Squadron [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|protected the convoy]], and also deterred an assault on the base itself by a lone [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Base appears in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']].
